consolidation_rationale: Four survivors share one axis (liveness-delivery / derive-on-read-liveness) and one underlying substrate (outcome_liveness.py plus team-execution's artifact-pointer machinery): extracting the reaper into a shared module is the necessary host for the other three facets (phi-accrual scoring, artifact-pointer-derived progress, acknowledged-idle-notification handshake) to land in one PR rather than four uncoordinated ones touching the same file.
dod_sketch: outcome_liveness generalized into a shared module any coordinator polls: suspicion score from heartbeat inter-arrival (phi-accrual), progress derived from artifact-pointer appearance, idle notifications requiring acknowledgment before being trusted.

executor_profile.justification: Mechanical extraction of one existing module into a shared one, wired to a second consumer, plus a well-bounded statistical addition over an existing heartbeat ledger, against two already-verified concrete integration points; no architectural ambiguity remains for /plan to resolve beyond module boundaries.
